message: analog function `{function}` assigns `{name}`, which is neither its name, one of its arguments, nor declared inside it; declare it with `real {name};`
description: An analog function can only write its own name (the return value), its `output`/`inout` arguments, and variables declared inside it. It cannot write the module's variables.
actions: Declare the variable inside the function (`real x;` before its statements).
If it is meant to be returned, make it an `output` argument or the function's return value.
